title: Honeyed Turkish Lamb Mince Kunafe
description: Rich, molten, and romantic Turkish dish featuring lamb mince, a bain-marie, and the crispy goodness of kunefe pastry.
instructions: In a large pan, cook the lamb mince until it is browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the honey, walnuts, cardamom powder, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Place a sheet of kunefe pastry on a flat surface and brush it with clarified butter.
Spoon the lamb mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1 cm border around the edges.
Sprinkle the feta cheese and pistachios over the lamb mixture.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with more clarified butter and cut the kunefe into diamond-shaped pieces.
Place the kunefe on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the kunefe from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
